campaign.title: Prove the B1 signed lift envelope and test its capacity for the M2 fat band

conductor_policy.monitoring: Conductor monitors parity, g-range truncation, weight variation, exact signed normalization, endpoint powers, and theorem provenance.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close with separate verdicts on the B1 pair-weight lemma and on B1's sufficiency for the signed fat-band energy. Do not infer a pointwise M2 estimate from a global moment.

numerical_purpose: falsify an exact finite identity or an endpoint normalization if necessary
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Finite signed ratios cannot validate an asymptotic signed-energy theorem.
resource_policy.literature_policy: The conductor will review primary literature for sign-preserving reciprocal or double-exponential-sum mechanisms and will distinguish structural analogy from theorem applicability.

frozen_target.question: Is the signed lift envelope A_chi(p/q)<<q/(D|p|) correct with exact support and weight hypotheses, and can that pointwise envelope alone control the signed M2 fat-band energy?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For reduced p/q, A_chi(p/q)=sum_{gq in [D,2D), 1<=|gp|<=H_D} beta_{gp,H_D} w_D(gq), with beta_{h,H}=-Phi(|h|/(H+1))chi_4(|h|)1_{2 not divides h}/(pi|h|). The candidate B1 estimate is A_chi=0 for even p and |A_chi(p/q)|<<q/(D|p|) for odd p under a fixed smooth or bounded-variation dyadic profile.
quantities: individual signed reduced-fraction lift weight A_chi(p/q)
l1 and l2 capacity implied by the B1 envelope
signed off-diagonal global fourth-moment fat-band form
pointwise S_2(D;X), explicitly excluded from any moment-only conclusion
forbidden_conflations: bounded weights with bounded-variation or fixed smooth weights
a pointwise bound on each A_chi with cancellation in a quadratic or quartic energy
the absolute value of a signed subtotal with a lower bound for the full signed form
a global fourth moment with a pointwise M2 estimate
a literature theorem with a merely analogous phase or parameter range

completion_criteria: A statement-only worker independently proves or refutes B1 with the exact g interval, parity support, truncation edge, and weight regularity.
A capacity analyst writes one exact normalization of the signed fat-band form and determines the strongest implication obtainable from B1 alone.
A hostile reviewer tests bounded, sharp, BV, fixed-profile, endpoint-truncated, and adversarial weights and checks whether the proposed argument proves a false unsigned analogue.
The conductor records a primary-literature method audit with exact applicability barriers.
The conductor separately accepts, revises, or rejects B1 and the B1-implies-signed-energy step.

tasks.target: Prove or refute the frozen B1 estimate from the exact beta formula. Track the nonempty g-range, p and g parity, the H_D truncation edge, Abel summation, and the weakest correct regularity assumption on w_D. Do not inspect prior B1 derivations or infer an energy estimate.

Define the frozen-coefficient smoothed global fourth moment and one exact signed off-diagonal fat-band form in reduced-fraction variables. Assuming B1 only, derive the strongest justified l1/l2/quartic bound or construct an envelope-saturating obstruction showing B1 cannot imply the desired signed energy. Keep the average-to-pointwise gap separate.

Attack both B1 and its proposed energy use. Test arbitrary bounded weights, sharp cutoffs, fixed smooth profiles, BV weights, short truncation intervals, p/q boundary cases, D=X^(1/3), X^(3/8), X^(1/2), and unsigned/adversarial coefficient controls. Identify the weakest surviving statement.

review_seams.requirement: Verify parity, beta normalization, and the exact g-sum.
Verify which weight norms make partial summation uniform, including short truncated intervals.
Determine what B1 alone implies for l1, l2, and the signed quartic form.
Reject every step that would equally prove a known-false unsigned or adversarial analogue.
Map exact theorem phases, coefficient classes, and parameter ranges before importing a method.

campaign.promotion_policy: Round 3 may promote B1 only with exact weight hypotheses, or record a no-go capacity result. No M9-M2, pointwise, M9, or final-theorem promotion is permitted.
